text:
olivia: Heads-up — nightly DAST produced a cluster of low-medium vuln hits and the CI job failed with KMS decrypt errors. Anyone touch keystore RBAC this morning? :eyes:
jun: saw that, I'm investigating. Did the job show the `permission denied` or `not found` error?
olivia: permission denied. Logs: ```bash
kubectl logs ci-runner-5f | tail -n 80
... ERROR: KMS: decrypt failed: permission denied for key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/build
``` 
michael: I pushed a tenancy change at 08:33 to reduce key access for service-accounts in `infra/ci-sa`. Might be related — I removed the role `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` from the group `ci-builders` earlier.
sara: FYI the DAST noise looks like a transitive dependency (nokogiri) — we have a suppression for one rule but not that endpoint. Should we triage separately?
jun: two tracks: (1) KMS RBAC rollback or scoped grant to fix CI ASAP; (2) triage DAST findings into vuln tracker. For CI hotfix I can temporarily re-grant `cryptoKeyDecrypter` to `ci-builders` for that key.
andrew: oncall is fine with temporary grant for 30m with audit log annotation. Ensure we create an issue to rotate creds if needed. :+1:
sec-bot: automated-audit: policy change detected by terraform at 2025-04-23T08:33Z by michael. Diff: -roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to group ci-builders
michael: yep that was me. Sorry, missed that `ci-runner` uses the group binding. I'll reapply a scoped binding to the specific service account instead of group.
olivia: sounds good. jun — can you also export the failing CI artifact and attach to vuln ticket? DAST report id: dr-2025-0423-9
jun: will do. attaching in asec-12345. Also adding a note to the postmortem template: include KMS bind checks for CI users.
sara: for the DAST items, let's create a single triage card per endpoint with repro steps and false-positive checklist. I'll start with `/api/upload`.
andrew: leaving a quick runbook note: if KMS permission denied for CI, check `gcloud kms keys list` -> `gcloud projects get-iam-policy` to validate bindings. Quick command I use: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy KEY --keyring=ci --location=global --project=redwood`
jun: hotfix applied at 08:46, CI re-run queued. will update once green. :rocket:
olivia: CI passed. thanks team. please follow through with scoped binding PR and DAST triage cards. I'll open a ticket for audit log search to show all uses of that key during window.
sec-bot: audit-log: 5 accesses to key `ci` between 08:30-08:50 UTC; 2 denied events recorded. Link: https://console.audit/redwood/ci-key
michael: opening PR now to bind `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to `serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` only, and add terraform test.
jun: after PR, let's run ephemeral test granting via `gcloud iam roles` and monitor with `gcloud logging filter` — I'll add to the playbook.
olivia: thanks all. We'll do a short blameless note in the weekly sec sync. :coffee:
